metadata.title: When you get 2 kills but act like you just clutched the whole game in VALORANT
metadata.description:
Wait, how did I even pull that off?
My aim was on vacation but somehow got 2 kills.
Watch me pretend it’s all skill and not pure luck.
VALORANT logic, you’re wild.

Click if your kills are accidents but you flex anyway!

#valorant #gamingfails #funnyclips #luckygamer #fps
